document.name: Ogaranya is a typeface born from the idea of power, wealth, kingship and conquest. The typeface takes inspiration from the visual language of African kingdoms and the sharp weapons carried by warriors who defended and expanded their empires. Spears, swords, blades and shields become ideas translated into typography — sharp edges, decisive cuts, strong structures and commanding forms. Every letter is designed to feel like it has been forged rather than drawn. Ogaranya was created with Africa in mind. Its character set extends beyond English to embrace the written languages and identities of Igbo, Yoruba and Hausa, giving African words the same visual authority traditionally reserved for global display typefaces.
